csbgen.name: ROGUE

enum.name: LOSSY
enum.doc: Sets the lossy bit for frame buffer compression.

value.name: U8U8U8
value.doc: 24-bit packed.

value.name: S8S8S8
value.doc: 24-bit packed.

value.name: PBYTE
value.doc: Order of packed bytes. Indicated by ROTMODE and MEML.

value.name: PWORD
value.doc: Order of packed (16-bit) words. Indicated by ROTMODE and MEML.

value.name: A2_XRBIAS_U10U10U10
value.doc: Same as the DX XRBIAS packmode BUT A[1:0] == '11'b should be set always.

value.name: YUV
value.doc: YUV placeholder pointing to the YUV_PMODE.

value.name: U10U10U10_XRBIAS_A2
value.doc: Same as the DX XRBIAS packmode BUT A[1:0] == '11'b should be set always.

enum.name: SIZE
enum.doc: Size of twiddled render in pixel units.

enum.name: SOURCE_FORMAT
enum.doc: Indicates USC output buffer packing. Not needed for F32 source format since the F32 packing mode automatically implies that the source format is F32 as well.

value.name: F16_PER_CHANNEL
value.doc: Only needed for F16 source format where the packing mode is equal to or less than 16-bits.

value.name: 8_PER_CHANNEL
value.doc: Only for 8-bits source formats where the packing mode is equal to or less than 8-bits.

value.name: SOURCE_CHAN0
value.doc: Indicates source channel0 goes to this destination channel.

value.name: SOURCE_CHAN1
value.doc: Indicates source channel1 goes to this destination channel.

value.name: SOURCE_CHAN2
value.doc: Indicates source channel2 goes to this destination channel.

value.name: SOURCE_CHAN3
value.doc: Indicates source channel3 goes to this destination channel.

value.name: ONE
value.doc: Send a value of 1 to this destination channel.

value.name: ZERO
value.doc: Send a value of 0 to this destination channel.

enum.name: TFBC_LOSSY
enum.doc: Sets the lossy bits for frame buffer compression.

value.name: LOSSLESS
value.doc: Lossless compression.

value.name: LOSSY75
value.doc: Lossy compression down to 75% of the original size.

value.name: LOSSY50
value.doc: Lossy compression down to 50% of the original size.

value.name: LOSSY25
value.doc: Lossy compression down to 25% of the original size.

enum.name: TWOCOMP_GAMMA
enum.doc: Sets the gamma mode for 2 component textures.

value.name: NO_DOWNSCALING
value.doc: No downscale applied.

value.name: ONE_SAMPLE_LEFT
value.doc: Cosited for 422 & 420, selects src0.

value.name: EMPTY
value.doc: Empty definition, for future use.

value.name: TWO_SAMPLES
value.doc: Centered for 422, Horizontally Centered & Vertically Cosited for 420, results to (src0+src1)/2.

value.name: FOUR_SAMPLES
value.doc: Centered for 420, results to (src0+src1+src2+src3)/4.

value.name: ONE_SAMPLE_RIGHT
value.doc: Cosited for 422 & 420, selects src1.

value.name: UV8_420_2PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit UV components from a YUV420 2 Plane format.

value.name: U8_420_3PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit U component from a YUV420 2 Plane format.

value.name: V8_420_3PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit V component from a YUV420 2 Plane format.

value.name: YUV8_422_1PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit YUV components from a YUV422 1 Plane format.

value.name: UV8_422_2PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit UV components from a YUV422 2 Plane format.

value.name: UV8_444_2PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit UV components from a YUV444 2 Plane format.

value.name: Y8_23PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit Y component from a YUV444/422/420 2/3 Plane format.

value.name: U8_444_3PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit U component from a YUV444 3 Plane format.

value.name: V8_444_3PLANE
value.doc: 8-bit V component from a YUV444 3 Plane format.

value.name: YUV10_444_1PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit YUV components from a YUV444 1 Plane format, packed in 32-bit word.

value.name: RESERVED_YUV1
value.doc: Reserved for future YUV packmodes.

value.name: RESERVED_YUV2
value.doc: Reserved for future YUV packmodes.

value.name: YUV10_422_1PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit packed YUV components from a YUV422 1 Plane format.

value.name: UV10_420_2PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit packed UV components from a YUV420 2 Plane format.

value.name: Y10_23PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit packed Y component from a YUV444/422/420 2/3 Plane format.

value.name: UV16_420_2PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit UV components from a YUV420 2 Plane format, packed as 16-bits in 32-bit word.

value.name: UV16_422_2PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit UV components from a YUV422 2 Plane format, packed as 16-bits in 32-bit word.

value.name: UV16_444_2PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit UV components from a YUV444 2 Plane format, packed as 16-bits in 32-bit word.

value.name: Y16_23PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit Y component from a YUV444/422/420 2/3 Plane format, packed as 16-bits in 32-bit word.

value.name: U16_444_3PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit U component from a YUV444 3 Plane format, packed as 16-bits in 32-bit word.

value.name: V16_444_3PLANE
value.doc: 10-bit V component from a YUV444 3 Plane format, packed as 16-bits in 32-bit word.

field.name: source_pos_offset_128
field.doc: Start position in source buffer offset from 128-bits.

field.name: norm
field.doc: Integer or fixed point packmode;0 - Integer, 1 - Fixed point.
